full_text_zh:
[P1] 小顽童科绘馆
来自火星的鸡
【认识太空】
好朋友童书 编绘
化学工业出版社
·北京·

[P2] 故事开始

[P3] 妈妈 再见
火星第一冒险王肯特坐上酷炫的飞行器准备出发了。
这一次，他要去海王星拍摄最美的极光。
爸爸 再见
知道更多
1846 年 9 月 23 日被发现的海王星，是太阳系八大行星中距离太阳最远的一颗行星，它有着如大海一般漂亮的淡蓝色光，也有着太阳系最强烈的风，测量到的时速高达 2100 公里。

[P4] 肯特刚出发没多久，就遇上了流星雨。
一颗颗拖着长尾巴的流星飞速地滑过，其中一颗“咚”的一声撞上了肯特的飞行器。飞行器被撞出了一个大洞后急速向前俯冲，完全不受肯特的控制了。
突然，一道刺眼的光芒划过，“救命呀！”肯特眼前一黑，晕了过去。
知道更多
流星是指宇宙中的流星体进入地球大气层，
与大气摩擦、燃烧所产生的光迹。大部分的流星体比沙砾还要小，比绿豆大一点的流星体进入大气层，就能产生肉眼可见亮度的流星。

[P5] 肯特醒来时，发现自己被一群尖嘴巴、长爪子的“怪物”
包围着。有高的、矮的、大的、小的、胖的、瘦的，而且身
上的颜色还各不相同。
肯特缩了缩脖子，问：“这是哪儿？你们是谁？”

[P6] 知道更多
早在 46 亿年前，地球就诞生了。在宇宙中，
地球是目前人类已知的、唯一存在生命的天体，
它用空气、水、土壤养育着上千万种人类已知的
和未知的生物。
“这里是地球，我们是咕咕镇的鸡宝宝。你又是谁？”
“我？我是来自火星的鸡，火星第一冒险王——肯特！”
“火星是个什么玩意儿？”咕咕鸡们七嘴八舌地炸开了锅。

[P7] 眼镜鸡走到肯特面前看了又看，之后大声地说：“他是个骗子！”
“什么，骗子？”咕咕鸡们都惊呆了。
眼镜鸡推了推眼镜，继续说：“他说他来自火星，可是大家想想，如果一只鸡住在全部是火的星球上，早就变成烤鸡了。”
“哈哈哈……”听了眼镜鸡的话，咕咕鸡们全都笑起来。

[P8] “胡说，火星上怎么可能全是火？”肯特气坏了，“等我修好了飞行器，带你们去火星看看！
“啊，快跑啊！
“我可不愿意变成烤鸡！
一听到肯特要带大家去火星，咕咕鸡们乱作一团，四处逃散。
知道更多
火星的直径约为地球的一半。火星外表呈橘红色，地表沙丘、砾石遍布，是一颗沙漠行星。2015 年 9 月 28 日，美国航天局（NASA）宣布，火星上存在液态水。

[P9] 从未受过如此打击的肯特失落极了，现在他只想赶快修好飞行器，离开地球。
可就在肯特专心修理飞行器时，突然传来一阵刺耳的哨声。
“不许动，举起手来！”还没等肯特反应过来，就被两位大鸡警察戴上手铐，抓进了咕咕鸡警察局。

[P10] 原来，咕咕鸡们以为肯特是拐骗小孩的坏蛋，就报了警。
在警察局，大家终于弄清了真相。
为了表示歉意，咕咕鸡们在鸡舍的草坪上准备了丰盛的午餐。在吃饭时，肯特和大家分享了许多游览太空的经历。
知道更多
水星上一滴水都没有；木星是太阳系里体积最大、自转最快的行星；土星的光环是最美丽的；北斗七星由七颗明亮的恒星组成，排列的形状像勺子。

[P11] 正当他们聊得起劲时，忽然一阵大风吹来，紧接着，太阳出现了一个大缺口，天色越来越暗，就像被一块黑布遮住了似的。
“妖怪要吃太阳了，大家快逃啊！”眼镜鸡大叫。
大家吓得四处乱窜。
看到如此惊慌失措的咕咕鸡们，肯特不禁大笑起来：“你们也太胆小了，哪有什么妖怪，这叫作‘日食’，等一会儿太阳就会出来的。”

[P12] 说完，肯特按了一下手腕上一个像手表一样的机器，顿时一道光射出并形成一个屏幕。咕咕鸡们都好奇地凑了过来。
“看，这就是日食。”肯特刚说完，屏幕上就出现了三颗圆球。肯特开始讲起日食的原理。

知道更多
当月球运动到太阳和地球的中间时，三者正好处在一条直线上，月球会挡住太阳射向地球的光。所以在地球上看起来就像太阳不见了，这就是“日食”。

[P13] “哦，原来是这样。如果太阳不是被妖怪吃掉的，那么月亮也不是被天狗吃掉的，对吗？”
鸡博士问。
“非常正确！”肯特对鸡博士竖起了大拇指。

知道更多
“天狗吃月亮”只是民间传说，这种天文现象叫“月食”。
月食是指当月球、地球和太阳处在一条直线上时，地球处于月亮和太阳之间，月球的部分地区被地球遮蔽了太阳光，因此我们看到的月亮就会缺了一部分。

[P14] 说着说着，太阳露出了云层，又将光芒重新洒满了大地。
“我们一起帮你修理飞行器吧！”，
“可是，飞行器的洞必须用一块纯碳构成的坚硬石头来修补。”
咕咕鸡们又开始七嘴八舌地议论起来……
“大家静一静，我们可以去找金刚石来修补飞行器。”鸡博士提议说。

[P15] 于是，在鸡博士的带领下，肯特和咕咕鸡们来到了俄罗斯一座大山的山洞前。肯特迫不及待地走了进去。
突然，一束绿光“唰”的一下照在肯特的身上。
很快，绿光、山洞和肯特竟然全都消失了！
鸡博士在之前洞口旁的大石头上发现了一个火星的标记。
“我明白了，这个山洞是有魔力的‘虫洞’，我想肯特现在应该已经回到了火星。”
知道更多
奥地利物理学家路德维希·弗莱姆首次提出了“虫洞”的概念。他认为“虫洞”是宇宙中连接两个不同时空的狭窄隧道。目前，人类对于“虫洞”的了解非常少，科学家们仍在努力探索更多“虫洞”的奥秘。

[P16] 回到火星的肯特每天都很想念
他的咕咕鸡朋友们。
而此时，在地球上的咕咕鸡们
正用金刚石修补肯特的飞行器呢！

等飞行器修好了，咕咕鸡们就会驾驶着它，去
火星看望他们的好朋友——火星第一冒险王肯特。
full_text_en:
[P1] Little Naughty Children's Science and Art Gallery
Chicken from Mars
[Getting to Know Space]
Compiled and illustrated by Good Friends Children's Books
Chemical Industry Press
·Beijing·

[P2] The story begins

[P3] Mom, goodbye
The Martian adventure king Kent is boarding his cool spacecraft to set off.
This time, he's going to Neptune to capture the most beautiful auroras.
Dad, goodbye
Did You Know?
Neptune, discovered on September 23, 1846, is the farthest planet from the Sun in the solar system. It has beautiful, sea-like pale blue light and the strongest winds in the solar system, measured at speeds up to 2100 km/h.

[P4] Kent had just set off for a while when he encountered a meteor shower.
One by one, meteors with long tails sped past. One of them hit Kent's spacecraft with a "thud." The spacecraft was struck with a big hole and plunged forward rapidly, completely out of Kent's control.
Suddenly, a blinding light flashed by. "Help!" Kent's vision went black, and he passed out.
Know More
Meteors are the trails of light produced when meteoroids from space enter Earth's atmosphere and burn up due to friction. Most meteoroids are smaller than sand grains. A meteoroid slightly larger than a mung bean entering the atmosphere can produce a meteor visible to the naked eye.

[P5] When Kent woke up, he found himself surrounded by a group of sharp-beaked, long-clawed 'monsters'.
They were tall, short, big, small, fat, thin, and each had different colors.
Kent shrank his neck and asked, 'Where is this? Who are you?'

[P6] Know More
Long before, 4.6 billion years ago, Earth was born. In the universe,
Earth is the only celestial body known to humans to harbor life,
and it nurtures tens of millions of known and unknown species with air, water, and soil.
"This is Earth, we are the chick babies of Gugu Town. And who are you?"
"Me? I'm a chicken from Mars, the first adventurer of Mars—Kent!"
"What's Mars?" The Gugu chickens chattered excitedly, causing a commotion.

[P7] The glasses-wearing chicken walked up to Kent, looked him over, and then shouted, “He’s a fraud!”
“What? A fraud?” The little chickens were stunned.
The glasses-wearing chicken pushed his glasses up and continued, “He says he’s from Mars. But think about it—if a chicken lived on a planet full of fire, it would have turned into roasted chicken long ago.”
“Hahaha……” Hearing the glasses-wearing chicken’s words, all the little chickens burst into laughter.

[P8] "Nonsense, how could Mars be full of fire?" Kent got angry, "Wait until I fix my spaceship, then I'll take you all to Mars to see for yourselves!"
"Ah, run away!"
"I don't want to become grilled chicken!"
As soon as the咕咕 chickens heard Kent wanted to take them to Mars, they panicked and scattered everywhere.
Know More
Mars has a diameter about half that of Earth. Its surface is reddish-orange, covered with sand dunes and gravel, making it a desert planet. On September 28, 2015, NASA announced the existence of liquid water on Mars.

[P9] Kent, who had never been hit so hard before, was extremely dejected. Now he just wanted to quickly fix his flying machine and leave Earth.
Just as Kent was concentrating on repairing his flying machine, a sharp whistle suddenly rang out.
"Don't move, hands up!" Before Kent could react, he was handcuffed by two big chicken police officers and taken to the Gugu Chicken Police Station.

[P10] Originally, the Gugu chickens thought Kent was a bad egg who kidnapped children, so they called the police.
At the police station, everyone finally figured out the truth.
To apologize, the Gugu chickens prepared a delicious lunch on the lawn of the chicken coop. While eating, Kent shared many of his space-traveling experiences with everyone.
Know More
There is not a single drop of water on Mercury; Jupiter is the largest and fastest-rotating planet in the solar system; Saturn's rings are the most beautiful; the Big Dipper consists of seven bright stars arranged in a shape like a ladle.

[P11] Just as they were chatting enthusiastically, suddenly a strong wind blew, and then the sun developed a big缺口, the sky growing darker and darker, as if covered by a black cloth.
"A monster is eating the sun, everyone run away!" cried the glasses-wearing chicken.
Everyone was frightened and scattered in all directions.
Seeing the panicked咕咕 chickens, Kent couldn't help but laugh: "You're all too timid. There's no monster. This is called a 'solar eclipse'. The sun will be back out in a moment."

[P12] After saying that, Kent pressed a device on his wrist that looked like a watch. Instantly, a beam of light shot out and formed a screen. The Gugu chickens all curiously gathered around.
"Look, this is a solar eclipse," Kent said. As soon as he finished, three round balls appeared on the screen. Kent began to explain the principle of a solar eclipse.

Know More
When the Moon moves between the Sun and the Earth, the three are aligned in a straight line. The Moon blocks the sunlight heading toward the Earth. So from Earth, it looks as if the Sun has disappeared. This is a "solar eclipse."

[P13] "Oh, so that's how it is. If the sun isn't eaten by a monster, then the moon isn't eaten by the heavenly dog either, right?"
Asked Chicken Doctor.
"Very correct!" Kent gave a thumbs-up to Chicken Doctor.

Know More
"The heavenly dog eating the moon" is just a folk tale; this astronomical phenomenon is called a "lunar eclipse".
A lunar eclipse occurs when the Moon, Earth, and Sun are aligned in a straight line, with Earth positioned between the Moon and the Sun. Part of the Moon is then blocked from sunlight by Earth, causing the Moon to appear partially missing from our view.

[P14] As they were talking, the sun emerged from the clouds and once again bathed the earth in light.
"Let's help you repair the flying machine!"
"But the hole in the flying machine must be patched with a hard stone made of pure carbon."
The little chickens began chattering excitedly again...
"Everyone, quiet down. We can go find diamonds to repair the flying machine," suggested Chicken Doctor.

[P15] Under the guidance of Chicken Doctor, Kent and the咕咕 chickens arrived at the entrance of a mountain cave in Russia. Kent couldn't wait and walked in.
Suddenly, a beam of green light "whoosh" hit Kent.
Quickly, the green light, the cave, and Kent disappeared completely!
Chicken Doctor found a Mars mark on a big stone beside the cave entrance.
"I understand now, this cave is a magical 'wormhole'. I think Kent has already returned to Mars."
Know More
Austrian physicist Ludwig Flamm first proposed the concept of a 'wormhole'. He believed that a 'wormhole' is a narrow tunnel connecting two different points in space and time. Currently, human understanding of 'wormholes' is very limited, and scientists are still striving to explore more of the mysteries of 'wormholes'.

[P16] Kent, back on Mars, misses his咕咕鸡 friends every day.
Meanwhile, on Earth, the咕咕鸡s are repairing Kent's spaceship with diamonds!

Once the spaceship is fixed, the咕咕鸡s will drive it to Mars to visit their good friend—Mars' first adventurer, Kent.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《来自火星的鸡》的封面，展示了书名、系列名称、编绘者和出版社信息，并配有一只穿着蓝色背心的卡通鸡形象。
[P2] 页面中央显示文字“故事开始”，下方是一只戴着眼镜、表情惊讶的卡通小鸡，标志着绘本故事的正式开启。
[P3] 火星冒险王肯特驾驶飞行器出发前往海王星拍摄极光，画面中他向父母告别，同时附有海王星的科普知识。
[P4] 肯特在前往海王星的途中遭遇流星雨，飞行器被流星撞出大洞后失控，他大喊救命并晕了过去。页面右侧附有流星的科普知识。
[P5] 肯特在昏迷后醒来，发现自己被一群形态各异、颜色不同的鸡群包围，他感到害怕并询问自己身处何地以及对方的身份。
[P6] 肯特醒来后发现自己身处地球的咕咕镇，被一群鸡宝宝包围。他自称是来自火星的冒险王，鸡宝宝们对此感到好奇和困惑，纷纷询问火星是什么。
[P7] 眼镜鸡质疑肯特来自火星的真实性，认为火星全是火，鸡住在那里会变成烤鸡，引得其他鸡宝宝们哄堂大笑。
[P8] 肯特因鸡宝宝们认为火星全是火而生气，承诺修好飞行器带他们去火星，结果鸡宝宝们惊慌逃散。页面下方附有火星的科普知识。
[P9] 肯特在修理飞行器时被鸡警察误抓，被戴上手铐带进了咕咕鸡警察局。
[P10] 肯特被误认为拐骗小孩的坏蛋而被报警，真相大白后，咕咕鸡们在草坪上为他准备了午餐，肯特向大家分享了自己游览太空的经历。
[P11] 肯特和鸡宝宝们正在聊天时，天空突然出现日食现象，鸡宝宝们误以为是妖怪吃太阳而惊慌逃窜，肯特解释这是日食并安抚大家。
[P12] 肯特用腕上的设备投影出日食原理图，向好奇的鸡宝宝们讲解日食现象，画面右侧附有日食的科普知识。
[P13] 鸡博士理解了日食原理后，向肯特提问月亮是否也被天狗吃掉，肯特肯定回答并给予赞许。页面右侧科普了月食的成因。
[P14] 日食结束后，鸡宝宝们决定帮助肯特修理飞行器，但因需要纯碳石头而议论纷纷，鸡博士提议去找金刚石来修补。
[P15] 在鸡博士的带领下，肯特和鸡宝宝们来到俄罗斯一座大山的山洞前，肯特进入山洞后被一道绿光带走消失不见，鸡博士发现山洞旁有火星标记，推测山洞是通往火星的虫洞。页面右侧附有虫洞的科普知识。
[P16] 肯特回到火星后思念地球上的咕咕鸡朋友们，而地球上的咕咕鸡们正在用金刚石修理他的飞行器，计划修好后前往火星探望他。
